additional_geometry: Body-fitted leather sleeves and greave liners
Two curved fur panels fitted to the belt contour (392 triangles each)
Four flexible leather straps attached to the belt surface (128 triangles each)

pants_revision.fit: Two top rows of each side-fur panel and leather strap are sampled from the actual belt surface and inset by 1.5 mm. Curved side panels are 6 mm thick, straps 3 mm thick; all attach to Hips. Lower rows have body clearance. Original central front/back pelt UVs and rigid hinge behavior are retained.
pants_revision.retained_body: Original base geometry and covered_skin material unchanged
pants_revision.license: Local edits of the existing project Meshy asset; no new AI generation or credits
pants_revision.runtime_simulation: Front/back pelts retain 1/60 s rigid pendulums. Two side pelts and four straps use 330 Verlet particles at 1/120 s with two fixed top rows, distance/shear/bending constraints, body ellipsoid contacts, and a 4% upper bound on vertical segment extension. Compression and folds are allowed. Belt attachment positions and normals are restored exactly. Free normals and shell thickness follow the deformed grid.
pants_revision.runtime_lifecycle: Character selection preview, player update and modular authoring preview; reset after teleport/hiding/scrub; dispose owned geometry on removal or character disposal
pants_revision.fallback: Generic GLB viewers and Blender use the exported static mesh and skin weights; physics runs in OpenMMO

renderer_checks: WebGLRenderer browser preview with shadows: no errors
physics.performance_scope: Single character in local headless Chrome; simulation and geometry updates, excluding rendering; no crowd or mobile benchmark
physics.limitations: Ellipsoid contacts are approximate. Stretch is capped while compression and folds are allowed. Self-collision, ground collision and exact triangle intersections are not simulated. Extreme poses and other equipment combinations are not guaranteed penetration-free.
